newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB no comment on St George merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB no comment on St George merger.

text.p: The National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB), which has a 6.8 percent stake in St George Bank Ltd, said on Monday it had no comment about the proposed merger between St George and Advance Bank Ltd.
"If you're looking for a comment from us then I don't know we're going to make one," NAB spokesman Hadyn Park told Reuters.
"We'll consider our position in due course," Park said.
NAB's stake in St George is widely seen as strategic stake to keep NAB's options open for a possible takeover bid of its own.
NAB bought 23 percent of Metway Bank Ltd's series one converting preference shares and voted in July to block St George's takeover bid for Metway.
